title: 24 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Prabodhini Ekadashi Celebrations, Ahmedabad, India
story:
Thousands of devotees participated in the Prabodhini Ekadashi celebrations in the presence of His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj at the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Ahmedabad. Prabodhini Ekadashi marks the offering of vegetables and fruits (Haatdi) to Thakorji.

In the mandir compound, lining Swamishri’s route to the mandir, baskets of many varieties of fruits and vegetables were displayed. Also, there were decorative displays before the murtis in the mandir shrines, where Swamishri performed the traditional arti. There, Swamishri sanctified the various fruits and vegetables that had been displayed.

options.headline: Dev Diwali 2007 in Bochasan
options.story:
Like every year an annakut was offered to Thakorji in all three shrines of the mandir on Dev Diwali. The Kartik Punam assembly commenced at 8.00 am on the grounds of Akshar-Purushottam Vidyalay: Viveksagar Swami spoke on Swamishri’s vicharan abroad. Children and youths of Adas mandal performed a cultural dance. Dr Swami spoke on how to become an ideal devotee. Ishwarcharan Swami gave highlights of the BAPS Centenary Celebrations to be held in Ahmedabad and invited all to attend.

26 November 2007 , (V.S. 2063-64, vad 2 ) Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of Shri Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, Shri Hanumanji, Shri Ganapatiji and Guru Parampara for the BAPS hari mandir in Ratanpura.

Performs abhishek of Shri Nilkanth Varni. Bapa and senior sadhus perform annakut arti. Bapa and bhaktas perform annakut arti. Performs annakut arti. In mandir pradakshina. options.story:
The painting in Nairobi

Today, in the last round of his walk, Mahant Swami Maharaj came with Siddhantnishthadas Swami. Then he said, "In Nairobi, on the wall of the sadhus' residence, there is a painting of sadhus, and in it one looks like this Swami. Side face... I have been looking at him for five days, today I said it..."

The sadhus from Africa had come at this time to benefit from the festival. They said, "Swami! You never even came to that side. For the last two days there you took your meals there, but this picture was at the side, one's eye would not naturally fall on it! So when could your eye have fallen on it!?"

And even if his eye had fallen on it, after seeing it, to remember those pictures and to catch that they resemble someone, how hard that is! And that too after 8 months!?

Then Swamishri said something else: "Another sadhu in that picture looks like Atmavijay Swami of Raysan."

Now, that Swami was not even present here, but Swamishri's photographic memory had captured everything. Photos quickly came over WhatsApp... They were shown to Swamishri... From them Swamishri pointed out both these sadhus.

options.headline: Shri Swaminarayan Mandir Murti Pratishtha Ceremony, Dholka, India
options.story:
Historical Significance Dholka is believed to be as ancient as the city of Dwarika established by Bhagwan Krishna. Dholka is noted to be the city of Virat as mentioned in the Mahabharat. It was here that the Pandavas spent their final year of exile in secrecy. Bhagwan Swaminarayan, Gunatitanand Swami and paramhansas had sanctified the land of Dholka.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj has visited Dholka several times. The newly built shikharbaddh Swaminarayan mandir is on a prime location near the Kheda-Bagodara highway. The land and the five-shikhar mandir was entirely sponsored by Shri Balkrishnabhai Patel (USA). His first request to Swamishri to create a mandir in his hometown of Dholka was made in 1977.

With the fluorishment of Satsang through the years, the need for a mandir arose and within a couple of years the mandir was ready. On 24 November 2001, a yagna was held and from 3:00 pm to 5:00 pm and a magnificent procession was carried out on the streets of Dholka.

On Sunday morning, 25 November 2001, Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha ceremony of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Ghanshyam Maharaj, Harikrishna Maharaj, Radha Krishna Dev, Sita Ram and Hanumanji, Shiv-Parvatiji and Ganpatiji, amidst the vedic chanting of mantras.

The main patrons of the mandir - Shri Balkrishnabhai Patel and his two sons, Pankaj and Hiren and other relatives - were also engaged in the mandir pratishtha rituals. Swamishri finally performed the murti pratishtha arti. Thereafter, during an assembly local leaders and dignitaries graced the occasion and extolled the glory of BAPS activities and Pramukh Swami Maharaj.

A beautiful dance with reference to the mandir inauguration was performed by local children and teenagers. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly praising the glory of Dholka and its sanctification by the holy feet of Shriji Maharaj. The inauguration of the Swaminarayan Mandir, Dholka, marked Swamishri's 15th shikharbaddh mandir inauguration.

Thousands of devotees participated in the Prabodhini Ekadashi celebrations in the presence of
His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj at the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Ahmedabad.
Prabodhini Ekadashi marks the offering of vegetables and fruits (Haatdi) to Thakorji.

In the mandir compound, lining Swamishri’s route to the mandir, baskets of many
varieties of fruits and vegetables were displayed. Also, there were decorative displays
before the murtis in the mandir shrines, where Swamishri performed the traditional arti.
There, Swamishri sanctified the various fruits and vegetables that had been displayed.
